description: AWS IAM access key of the tenant account (write-only).

fields.description: IAM access key id; AKIA… for a long-term key, ASIA… for temporary STS credentials.
fields.name: access_key_id
fields.title: Access key id

fields.description: Secret half of the access key (40 base64 characters).
fields.name: secret_access_key
fields.title: Secret access key

fields.description: STS session token; required with temporary (ASIA…) credentials, absent otherwise.
fields.name: session_token
fields.title: Session token

rules.message: session_token is required when: ("access_key_id" in root) && root.access_key_id.startsWith("ASIA")
a session token belongs to temporary (ASIA…) credentials only
